safeInterpretation: Use plugin, MCP, connector, and installed AI inventory as supervised planning context over a ten-year horizon without unapproved live activation.
liveBoundary: No connector write, remote MCP trust, provider credential use, external AI file or prompt send, plugin install or publish, SSH, deployment, billing, cloud spend, push, merge, tag, release, or production-readiness claim is allowed from this map.

horizon.cadence: H1/H2 review windows for each year

phases.name: Working Demo
phases.focus: Keep the SEIS Desktop, Second Brain, Command Center, local MCP runtime, installed AI registry, and plugin catalog visible in a no-key demo.
phases.deliverable: Browser-local continuity panel, report artifact, and validator-backed no-live-activation boundary.
phases.boundary: No live connector or provider execution.

phases.name: Alpha
phases.focus: Turn plugin/MCP/installed-AI inventory into scoped read-only capability routing with explicit user approval gates.
phases.deliverable: Read-only activation matrix with connector-by-connector status and review cadence.
phases.boundary: No credentialed writes without explicit approval.

phases.name: Beta
phases.focus: Add validated workspace intelligence, repository memory, and local-only AI-assisted review workflows.
phases.deliverable: Evidence-backed workspace context packs and local review handoffs.
phases.boundary: No private vault import or external AI prompt/file sending by default.

phases.name: Platform
phases.focus: Move approved MCP/plugin lanes toward enterprise-grade observability, rollback, and permission models.
phases.deliverable: Policy-backed lane dashboards and audit trails.
phases.boundary: No production mutation without owner approvals and rollback evidence.

phases.name: Full Ecosystem
phases.focus: Unify Desktop OS, AI Core, Search, Code, Design, Cloud, Store, Music, Files, Terminal, Agents, Plugins, and Command Center.
phases.deliverable: Public-safe ecosystem review pack and extensibility readiness report.
phases.boundary: No public release without security owner signoff.

phases.name: Ecosystem Scale
phases.focus: Introduce marketplace-quality plugin intake, versioned capability contracts, and quality gates.
phases.deliverable: Trusted plugin intake governance with reproducible checks.
phases.boundary: No marketplace publishing without license, security, and provenance review.

phases.name: Enterprise Operations
phases.focus: Harden role-based activation, connector approval records, audit logs, and organization-grade safety controls.
phases.deliverable: Enterprise activation policy and governance evidence ledger.
phases.boundary: No customer or private organization data in public artifacts.

phases.name: Knowledge Runtime
phases.focus: Use the Second Brain as a governed knowledge runtime for agent context, prompt packs, and retrieval boundaries.
phases.deliverable: Reviewed context packs with public/private separation and retrieval provenance.
phases.boundary: No unreviewed memory writes become source of truth.

phases.name: Autonomy Readiness
phases.focus: Evaluate bounded automation with strict task scopes, approval gates, failure behavior, and rollback.
phases.deliverable: Autonomy readiness report with denied-action evidence and human escalation paths.

phases.name: Public Platform Maturity
phases.focus: Prepare SEIS as a mature public platform with sustainable plugin, MCP, installed AI, and governance loops.
phases.deliverable: Ten-year maturity review pack and next-decade governance plan.
phases.boundary: No claim of completed ten-year execution until evidence exists.
